Глутатион.about: The main intracellular antioxidant. The problem is poor absorption when taken orally. NAC works indirectly - as a predecessor.
Глутатион.caution: Oral glutathione is poorly absorbed—most is destroyed in the GI. The liposomal form is better. IV glutathione - only in the clinic (used in cosmetology, but its effectiveness in skin whitening has not been confirmed). Avoid during pregnancy without advice.
Глутатион.course: 8-12 weeks; the effect orally is weak
Глутатион.food_sources: In food - as part of proteins (meat, fish, avocado, asparagus). The body synthesizes it itself - in the absence of a deficiency, supplements are useless.
Глутатион.guidelines: EFSA does not approve health claims. In clinical medicine - IV for poisoning, paracetamol hepatitis.
Глутатион.how_to_choose: Liposomal glutathione (better bioavailability) or NAC (as a precursor, cheaper and more effective).
mechs: Primary cell antioxidant: neutralizes free radicals
Support of glutathione pool in lymphocytes
Глутатион.myths: “Skin whitens” is a popular myth in Asia, no RCT. “Improves everything” is an exaggeration. NAC often works better and is cheaper.
Глутатион.name: Glutathione
Глутатион.onset: 4-8 weeks for changes in tests (blood levels); on health - not noticeable.
Глутатион.title: Glutathione
Глутатион.upper_limit: There is no formal UL. Doses up to 2 g/day are well tolerated.
Глутатион.who_needs: People with oxidative stress (chronic diseases, smoking). For HIV, diabetes, liver disease - deficiency. In cosmetology - intravenously for “whitening” (the effect has not been confirmed by RCT).
